gloss: always having on hand; keeping in stock; standing (army, equipment)

definitions.gloss: always having on hand; keeping in stock; standing (army, equipment)
definitions.explanation: Used for items or resources kept available at all times for regular or emergency use.

examples.japanese: {常備|じょうび}{薬|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have any medicines you keep on hand?

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{常備|じょうび}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are ingredients I always keep stocked in the fridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{非常|ひじょう}{用|よう}→非常用：28550_hijouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう}→懐中電灯：05479_kaichuudentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{常備|じょうび}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おくべきだ。
examples.english: You should always keep an emergency flashlight at home.

notes:
Means keeping something always available and ready to use. The word combines {常|じょう} (always) and {備|び} (preparation). In everyday use, it most commonly appears in the compound {常備薬|じょうびやく} (medicines kept on hand) and in cooking contexts where people talk about ⟦{常備菜|じょうびさい}→常備菜：19169_joubisai⟧ (prepared dishes kept ready in the fridge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常備薬|じょうびやく}: medicines kept on hand
- ⟦{常備菜|じょうびさい}→常備菜：19169_joubisai⟧: meal-prepped side dishes
- {常備|じょうび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep on hand, stock regularly
- {常備品|じょうびひん}: items kept in stock
- {常備軍|じょうびぐん}: standing army

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧: stockpiling — emphasizes accumulating reserves, especially for emergencies
- ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧: preparation — broader term for getting something ready
